mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% compresses equity discount rates and increases risk appetite, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as investors shift capital from fixed income to equities.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS remains below 2.0%, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 0.5 percentage point monthly increase in unemployment rate above 4.0% signals deteriorating labor market health, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0%, or signal Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 and retail sales (RSAFS) below 500,000 million dollars indicate broad consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days as recession risks intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent inflation above 5.0% year-over-year (CPIAUCSL > 5.0%) forces the Federal Reserve to accelerate rate hikes, increasing real discount rates and reducing equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL exceeds 5.0%, or signal Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in industrial production (INDPRO) below 105.0 indicates manufacturing sector weakness, reducing corporate capital expenditure and profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when INDPRO falls below 105.0, or signal Rank IC drops below 0.02 in any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1200.0 thousand units signals real estate market weakness, reducing household wealth and consumer spending, which generates negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when HOUST falls below 1200.0, or signal Rank IC remains below 0.03 in any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly decline in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) below 145,000 thousand indicates labor market slack, reducing consumer confidence and corporate hiring, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when PAYEMS falls below 145000.0, or signal Rank IC drops below 0.02 in any 1-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent increases in inflation (CPIAUCSL) and federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signal aggressive monetary tightening, raising real interest rates and dampening economic growth, which drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or interaction signal Rank IC falls below 0.02 in any 3-year window.
